Sandbox_Automaker_fullbuild_tooltip: If off, built vehicles spawn stripped of parts and needing repair instead of fully finished.
Sandbox_StopThePlantRot_tooltip: Stops fully grown crops from rotting of old age
Sandbox_UnhotwireVehicle_ElectricalLevel: Minimum Electrical level needed to remove a working hotwire from a car.
Sandbox_UnhotwireVehicle_MechanicsLevel_: Minimum Mechanics level needed to remove a working hotwire from a car.
Sandbox_StopThePlantRot_DaysBeforeRot_to:
How many extra in-game days a fully grown crop stays harvestable after the point it would normally rot.
0 = Never rots (default). Watering and disease still matter: a neglected crop can still die.
